0.0.n: This is the name of the animation studio, written in katakana.

0.1.n: Links ジブリ to 魅力, showing whose charm it is.

0.2.n: Refers to the appealing qualities associated with Ghibli.

0.3.n: Marks 魅力 as what is present in abundance.

0.4.n: Originally describes a full load; here it emphasizes abundant charm, with です omitted for a punchy advertising style.

1.0.n: The studio name appears here as part of the collection title.

1.1.n: Marks ジブリ as what there is plenty of in this title.

1.2.n: Expresses abundance; ジブリがいっぱい suggests a collection full of Ghibli material.

1.3.n: This English word is used directly as part of the release title.

1.5.n: Part of the title, this refers here to very short films rather than the very short stories it often describes.

1.7.n: This year marks the beginning of the date range in the title.

1.9.n: This year marks the end of the date range in the title.

2.0.n: The disc format name is written in katakana.

2.1.n: Connects the two available formats, ブルーレイ and DVD.

2.2.n: The disc format is written using its English initials.

2.3.n: Marks Blu-ray and DVD as the formats in which the release is available.

2.4.n: Combines with 月 to specify the seventh month, July.

2.5.n: After a number, 月 names a calendar month; 7月 is July.

2.6.n: Gives the day of the month; 17日 is read じゅうしちにち.

2.7.n: A compact advertising expression announcing that a product is going on sale for the first time.

0.tip: Japanese ads often omit です, letting a noun like 満載 finish the sentence.

1.lit: Lots of Ghibli SPECIAL Short Shorts 1992–2016.
1.tip: This is a release title, with 1992–2016 giving the year range of its contents.

2.lit: On Blu-ray and DVD, July 17, new release!
2.tip: The particle で marks the release formats here, not the release date.
